item.title: Claude Scientific Skills
item.description:
This is a collection of ready-to-use skills for working with specialized scientific libraries and databases, packaging domain knowledge that’s otherwise scattered across niche documentation.

Why a skill for this

Scientific computing libraries often have small, specialist user bases and thin documentation. Bundling working knowledge of them as skills saves re-deriving usage patterns from source code or sparse docs each time.
